selected_evidence.summary: Shows /swapfile is exactly 536870912 bytes, mode 0600, root-owned, and has a valid swap signature.
Kernel swap tables show /swapfile active immediately after configuration.
Shows the exact fstab entry, successful fstab-only reactivation, and active swap after reboot.

Captures healthy pre-restart swap state, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID changing from b4b69219-1353-4702-80fa-ad8a35f37714 to c62d9fb3-3dc6-4cff-a864-01707ddc54d9, and full post-restart swap recovery.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*/swapfile[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '\n/swapfile none swap sw 0 0\n' >> /etc/fstab
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTENT_SWAP_ENTRY'
grep -En '^[[:space:]]*/swapfile[[:space:]]+none[[:space:]]+swap[[:space:]]+sw[[:space:]]+0[[:space:]]+0[[:space:]]*$' /etc/fstab

set -u
swapoff /swapfile
if swapon -a; then
  printf '%s\n' 'FSTAB_REACTIVATION_SUCCEEDED'
  swapon --show --bytes
  exit 0
fi
printf '%s\n' 'FSTAB_REACTIVATION_FAILED; attempting direct recovery' >&2
swapon /swapfile || true
exit 1

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'PRE_RESTART_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' 'SWAP_FILE_METADATA'
stat -c 'path=%n bytes=%s mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /swapfile
[ "$(stat -c %s /swapfile)" -eq 536870912 ]
[ "$(stat -c %a /swapfile)" = 600 ]
printf '%s\n' 'SWAP_SIGNATURE'
blkid -p /swapfile
printf '%s\n' 'ACTIVE_KERNEL_SWAP'
cat /proc/swaps
awk 'NR > 1 && $1 == "/swapfile" { found=1 } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' /proc/swaps
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTENT_CONFIGURATION'
grep -En '^[[:space:]]*/swapfile[[:space:]]+none[[:space:]]+swap[[:space:]]+sw[[:space:]]+0[[:space:]]+0[[:space:]]*$' /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' 'SYSTEMD_SWAP_UNIT'

systemctl list-units --type=swap --all --no-pager
